description: Optional modifier modules for wibandwob. Edit 'enabled_modules' to activate.

usage.example_command: jq '.enabled_modules += ["chaos-amplifier"]' ralph-modules.json > tmp.json && mv tmp.json ralph-modules.json

notes: Modules are optional - base wibandwob prompt is complete without them
Use chaos-amplifier to increase Wib (chaotic/artistic) influence
Use structure-amplifier to increase Wob (geometric/precise) influence
